title: DAO→tunnel-auth trigger and capability-table consult unwired in all stacks (spec 8.11 SHOULD / 8.12 R-06-319/330)
description: The tunnel-auth issuance loop is never driven: no stack forwards a DAO route-installed event to the tunnel-auth sender, and no stack consults the capability table to decide. Evidence (R-06-319/330): C emits a route_installed flag from DAO processing (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:823-956) but nothing forwards it to lichen_tunnel_auth_route_installed (gateway/tunnel_auth.c:248-261, test-only caller); Python RootTunnelAuthorizer.route_installed (gateway/tunnel_auth.py:309-346, egress_capable gate :328-329) has test-only callers; Rust build_root_post (lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:142-161) has no capability gate and test-only callers. §8.12 'check capability table for that node's IID; if egress bit 0 set and prefix matches, send tunnel-auth' is implemented in NO stack. b7z9.35 (tunnel-auth wiring) is partially stale — endpoints + egress gates landed; this bead covers the remaining trigger + consult. Suggested placement: root/BR binaries — rust/lichen-gateway (DAO processing → capability table → build_root_post), C lichen/apps/gateway + rpl/rpl_dao_process.c, python node.py/gateway.
